high.title: Inflation Forecast Falls for 2026 but Rises for Subsequent Years; Check Monday's Focus Report (27)
high.summary: The Banco Central do Brasil's weekly Focus survey reveals a continued — though modest — easing of near-term inflation expectations, with the 2026 IPCA forecast trimmed from 5.15% to 5.12%. However, the medium-to-long-term inflation outlook is deteriorating at the margin: 2027 expectations edged up from 4.20% to 4.22%, 2028 from 3.78% to 3.80%, while 2029 held steady at 3.50%.

medium.title: Petrobras (PETR4): Board Approves Election of New Energy Transition Director; See Who Takes Over
medium.summary:
Petrobras' board of directors approved the appointment of William Vella Nozaki as interim Executive Director of Energy Transition and Sustainability (DTEN), effective August 1, 2026. Nozaki previously served as Executive Manager of Integrated Energy Transition Management at Petrobras since August 2024 and is a board member of Transpetro. While this is a routine executive change, leadership continuity at Petrobras' sustainability division carries relevance for ESG-focused foreign investors in PETR4, given ongoing scrutiny of the company's energy transition strategy. As a major Ibovespa component and key driver of Brazil's trade balance and fiscal revenues, any shifts in Petrobras' strategic direction warrant monitoring by equity and macro investors alike.

medium.title: European Stock Markets Rise on Earnings and Oil Price Decline Following US-Iran Truce
medium.summary: European equities advanced on Tuesday morning, with the pan-European Stoxx 600 up 0.40% to 647.18 points, driven by positive corporate earnings — notably Unilever surging 7% on strong organic growth — and declining oil prices following a US-Iran ceasefire. For Brazilian market participants, this is marginally relevant as a risk-on global backdrop can support capital flows into emerging markets including Brazil, potentially providing modest BRL support. Additionally, falling oil prices carry a dual implication for Brazil: they may pressure Petrobras revenues and the Brazilian equity market, while simultaneously easing inflationary pressures on fuel and transportation costs — a factor the BCB monitors closely when calibrating Selic rate decisions. Watch whether this oil weakness sustains, as it could influence IPCA expectations and the trajectory of monetary easing discussions.

medium.title: Chinese Stocks Fall to One-Week Low on Technology Sector Decline
medium.summary: Chinese equities declined to a one-week low on Tuesday, with the Shanghai Composite falling 1.2%, the CSI 300 dropping 2.8%, and the Hang Seng also retreating, as investors reassessed high valuations amid concerns over rising chip production capacity and elevated AI infrastructure spending. For Brazil-focused investors, weakness in Chinese markets is relevant given China's status as Brazil's largest trading partner and the primary driver of demand for Brazilian commodities such as iron ore and soybeans. Sustained risk-off sentiment in China could weigh on Vale's share price and drag on the Ibovespa, while also putting downward pressure on the BRL through reduced commodity export revenues and deteriorating terms of trade.
